fields.label: Your name
fields.help: Shown on your wall and to your friends.

fields.label: About you
fields.help: A line or two at the top of your wall.

fields.label: New posts are for
fields.help: friends: only your friends see them. public: everyone who opens your wall, and your followers. You can choose per post too.

fields.label: Others can ask to be friends
fields.help: Off: no new friend requests come in; your friends stay.

fields.label: This house's name
fields.help: The first part of the house's address, like anna for anna.okayiris.com. Filled in by itself once someone opens your wall.
